instructions: Loyalty slots only — IHG tier benefits source

rows.body: Kimpton Hotels · IHG One Rewards — tier benefits at a glance

IHG One Rewards spans 6,000+ global destinations. Members earn toward Reward Nights with no blackout dates on Reward Nights, access Member Rates on direct bookings, and unlock elite tiers (Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond) with bonus points, upgrades, and Milestone Rewards choices every 10 nights from 20 nights per calendar year.

Model loyalty as net contribution after member discounts, elite benefits, and IHG program chargebacks — not headline ADR.
IHG One Rewards generated an average of 50.8% of Kimpton Hotels bookings (2025 U.S. comparable hotels per Kimpton development brochure / FDD source note). IHG booking channels represented an average of 88.5% of Kimpton reservations in the same period.
IHG One Rewards reports 100M+ members globally (Kimpton development web capture).
Confirm Kimpton-specific loyalty P&L in your FDD Item 19 sample and IHG program fee schedule.

rows.title: 6,000+ Destinations
rows.body: Reward Nights redeemable at 6,000+ global destinations (IHG One Rewards tier benefits page).

rows.title: No Blackout Dates
rows.body: No blackout dates on Reward Nights for members (IHG One Rewards tier benefits page).

rows.title: Member Rates
rows.body: Exclusive lowest rates for members booking direct (IHG One Rewards tier benefits page).

rows.title: Milestone Rewards
rows.body: Choose a reward every 10 qualified nights from 20 nights per year, up to 100 nights.

rows.title: Five Elite Tiers
rows.body: Club, Silver Elite, Gold Elite, Platinum Elite, and Diamond Elite — published qualification thresholds on ihg.com.

rows.title: InterContinental Ambassador
rows.body: Separate invite-only Ambassador program for InterContinental — not the same as IHG One Rewards elite tiers.

Earn points on eligible stays; elite tiers add 20%–100% bonus points on top of base earn (per tier).
Member Rates on direct bookings — lowest rates exclusive to members when booking direct.
Member Promotions to accelerate earn during IHG campaigns.
Milestone Rewards: starting at 20 qualified nights, choose a reward every 10 nights (up to 100 nights) — bonus points, F&B rewards, suite upgrades, or lounge membership per program rules.

Redeem points for Reward Nights at 6,000+ global destinations — no blackout dates on Reward Nights.
Redeem for experiences, catalog items, and partner options per current program rules.
Platinum and Diamond elites may access promotional Reward Night discounts (per IHG program terms).

rows.title: Club Member
rows.body: Join for free — Earn points toward Reward Nights and more; no blackout dates on Reward Nights; Member Rates and Member Promotions; complimentary Wi-Fi; late check-out to 2pm (subject to availability).

rows.title: Silver Elite
rows.body: 10 qualified nights — All Club benefits plus 20% bonus points on stays; points do not expire while you maintain Elite status.

rows.title: Gold Elite
rows.body: 20 qualified nights or 40,000 qualified points — All Silver benefits plus 40% bonus points; rollover nights toward next year's status; Milestone Rewards choice starting at 20 nights (every 10 nights, up to 100); Hertz Gold Plus Five Star status match.

rows.title: Platinum Elite
rows.body: 40 qualified nights or 60,000 qualified points — All Gold benefits plus 60% bonus points; guaranteed room availability (72 hours advance, blackout dates apply); complimentary upgrades when available; Reward Night discounts; Welcome Amenity at check-in; early check-in when available; Hertz Five Star status match.

rows.title: Diamond Elite
rows.body: 70 qualified nights or 120,000 qualified points — All Platinum benefits plus 100% bonus points; Dedicated Diamond Elite support line; Welcome Amenity at check-in (includes daily free hot breakfast for two option); Hertz President's Circle status match.

Underwrite net room revenue after IHG One Rewards participation, member-rate leakage, Reward Night redemptions, and loyalty marketing assessments in your FDD — Kimpton brochure cites ~50.8% loyalty booking mix and ~88.5% IHG channel mix (illustrative; confirm in your disclosure).
Elite welcome amenities (points, drink/snack, or breakfast at Diamond), upgrades, and late check-out create operating load — staff to IHG elite recognition standards before campaigns.
Mandatory IHG CRS/PMS loyalty integration, member pricing, and Milestone Rewards fulfillment — budget cutover, training, and ongoing program compliance.
